title: CAR-003 Calibration Completion
description: FR-037, FR-038. Proof that a specific calibration run finished, and which evidence it produced. The frozen analysis plan binds this alongside the calibration protocol: the protocol proves the pre-calibration design, this proves the execution the plan's numbers actually came from. Binding only the protocol would let a plan claim derivation from a design without naming the run that produced its variance estimates. Mirrors G56R-003's calibration-completion contract; see calibration_protocol_binding for the one field that differs and why.

calibration_protocol_binding.description: FR-037. The versioned calibration protocol this run executed.

calibration_evidence_bindings.description: The committed calibration evidence records this completion attests to, by id and digest.

analysis_plan_observed.description: FR-037. Pinned false: no analysis plan exists while calibration runs, which is the whole reason calibration binds the protocol rather than the plan.

cohort_outcome_observed.description: SC-012. Pinned false: calibration completes before any cohort outcome is observed.

independent_review_binding.description: AC-2.20 independent validity review. Nullable on CAR-003 and NOT nullable on the G56R-003 mirror, because the two calibration protocols differ in shape: the Codex protocol carries scorer, rubric, adjudicator, cache-policy, and independent-review bindings, while CAR-003's protocol is a leaner anti-cycle token that carries only the objective bindings, the partition binding, and the three carries-no-margins/sample-sizes/thresholds assertions. The CAR-003 calibration pilot scored with declared deterministic rubric scorers rather than model scorers, so no independent review artifact exists to bind and one MUST NOT be authored retroactively to fill the field. Null records that absence honestly. Bringing the CAR-003 calibration protocol up to the Codex protocol's shape is tracked as roadmap spec CAR-012; once it carries an independent review binding, this field becomes required here too and the mirror closes.
